title: node-manifest
description: The manifest.json shipped at the root of each Node repo: the static description of one Node (not a Host-level plugin, and not node-demo). It is the single source of the static fields; a Node adds its build-stamped version and the Host serial at runtime and publishes the result as Node info (see node-info.schema.json). version and host_serial are FORBIDDEN here so a hand-edited version can never disagree with the release tag. Home Assistant field mapping, for anyone bridging Node info to an HA device block (documented here only; nothing HA-shaped goes on the wire): product -> model, version -> sw_version, host_serial -> serial_number, homepage -> configuration_url, node -> identifiers. host_serial formats seen so far: a Raspberry Pi SoC serial, the Serial line of /proc/cpuinfo (16 hex digits, e.g. 10000000abcdef01; an all-zero or empty value is treated as absent), and an ESP32 MAC address as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Every Node repo's CI validates manifest.json against this schema fetched from the hub repo at a pinned ref; schema/validate-examples.sh fails when an entity schema exists that the publishes enum does not list.

node.description: The Node's key: the topic segment in renewvan/<node>/info and renewvan/<node>/health, and the Home Assistant device identifier. A lowercase slug with no node- prefix (repo renewvan/node-venus is node 'venus'). The reserved key 'demo' is rejected: it is the Demo namespace root, never a Node.

product.description: Human-readable product name shown as the Node's title (Home Assistant: model).

source.description: What the Node reads: the hardware or feed it senses or remaps (e.g. 'Victron Venus OS MQTT feed', 'ADS1115 resistive sender').

publishes.description: Entity types the Node publishes. A static enum kept in sync with the entity schemas under schema/ by schema/validate-examples.sh: adding an entity schema without listing it here fails that script (in both this schema and node-info.schema.json).

manufacturer.description: Optional. Who makes the Node. Consumers show 'renewvan' when Node info exists without one.

homepage.description: Optional. Project or product URL (Home Assistant: configuration_url).
